fat-cat-on-a-mat.5:
The tree bends...
...and the
nest drops
off the end.
fat-cat-on-a-mat.8:
"Bake a cake with me,"
says Jake Snake.
"Not today," says Fat Cat on her mat.
"Let's run in the sun for fun," says Ted.
"Not today," says Fat Cat on her mat.

fox-on-a-box.2:
Hungry Fox spots
a box.
Hungry Fox
hops onto
the box.
He tries to reach...
fox-on-a-box.4:
Hungry Fox pushes the box.
"Now I'm as tall as
the wall!" calls Fox.
fox-on-a-box.7:
SPLAT!
Hungry Fox sits on the box.
fox-on-a-box.9:
But a tug from Duck
means he's out
of luck.
SPLAT!
Hungry Fox
is on the box.
fox-on-a-box.10:
"I can reach
the cooling
pies!" cries
Fox.
But Pup and
Fat Cat...
...put a stop to that.
fox-on-a-box.11:
Hungry Fox falls
into the box.
He heaves
himself out...
fox-on-a-box.13:
"I'm back in the box!"
shouts Happy Fox.

frog-on-a-log.10:
So Big Pig and Pup the dog
bump into the log...
...which tips back into the bog...
...taking with it foolish Frog.

goose-on-the-loose.10:
But Goose has stopped, and feels a fool.
She's landed in the penguin pool!

sam-sheep-cant-sleep.5:
Ted is asleep in his red bed.
Pup barks in the
dark night...
sam-sheep-cant-sleep.9:
"Can't sleep?" says Big Pig. "Then do a jig."
"That will make you sleep, Sam Sheep."
So Pup starts to jiggle.
Fat Cat starts
to wiggle.
Ted does a wriggle.
sam-sheep-cant-sleep.11:
But what about Sam Sheep?
Sam Sheep is asleep!
